say:5:1861106003:1.text: How could I forget? You got lost in the forest that time.
say:5:1861106003:1.source_cn: 记得，那次你在森林里迷路了。

say:6:1861106004:1.text: By the time the two of you finally found me, it was already dark, and we were completely exhausted. So we just lay down on the grass and stretched out.

say:10:1861106005:0.text: I'm so sorry... It's all my fault you're both stuck out here and missing the festival.

say:11:1861106006:0.text: Don't be too hard on yourself.
say:11:1861106006:0.source_cn: 爱丝，这不是你的错，你不必自责。

say:12:1861106007:0.text: We can still celebrate Fall Harvest right here.
say:12:1861106007:0.source_cn: 秋夜节在哪里都可以过。

say:13:1861106008:0.text: Besides, we found this great stargazing spot thanks to you!
say:13:1861106008:0.source_cn: 而且，要不是因为你，我们也不会发现这处绝佳的看星星的地方。

say:14:1861106009:0.text: Look at all those stars... It feels like they're shining just for us.

say:27:1861106018:0.text: I swear, this is the best thing I've ever had.
